title: match encoder blit egl config class

commit.merge_subject: merge: match encoder blit egl config class

description:
The white-window round 4 probe extension (the brief's optional
commit 2 — free, so landed). The per-attach geometry line now also
carries the CHOSEN CONFIG's class: four one-shot eglGetConfigAttrib
reads per attach — EGL_RENDERABLE_TYPE, EGL_SURFACE_TYPE,
EGL_NATIVE_VISUAL_ID and the EGL_RECORDABLE_ANDROID verdict —
appended to the existing 'window probe: attach win=... dots=...'
line as cfg[renderable=0x.. surface=0x.. visual=N recordable=R].

Purpose: the round-4 fix (783ba1d) added EGL_RECORDABLE_ANDROID to
the preview session's eglChooseConfig attribs; this line lets the
owner's device replay CONFIRM the config class actually changed
(recordable=1) on the same one-shot-per-attach line that already
reports the surface geometry — no second build, no new readback,
zero per-frame cost (release builds never reach the block; the
latch keeps it once per attach).

The round-3 evidence chain
